def load_json(path):
    if os.path.exists(path):
        return pd.read_json(path, lines=True)
    # Fallback for alternative structures
    try:
        if os.path.exists(os.path.dirname(path) + "/" + os.path.basename(path)):
            return pd.read_json(path)
    except:
        return None
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"File {path} not found.")

    for col in ["requester_subreddits_at_request"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = (
                df[col]
                .fillna([])
                .apply(lambda x: " ".join(x) if isinstance(x, list) else str(x))
            )
    # Fill numeric NaNs
    num_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns
    df[num_cols] = df[num_cols].fillna(0)
    # Ensure object type for text
    text_cols = ["request_text_edit_aware", "request_text", "request_title"]
    # Remove unnecessary columns if present that might leak info
    # Keep only features mentioned in schema
    # Filter columns strictly
    valid_cols = [
        "number_of_downvotes_of_request_at_retrieval",
        "number_of_upvotes_of_request_at_retrieval",
        "post_was_edited",
        "request_number_of_comments_at_retrieval",
        "request_text",
        "request_text_edit_aware",
        "request_title",
        "requester_account_age_in_days_at_request",
        "requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_request",
        "requester_number_of_comments_at_request",
        "requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_request",
        "requester_number_of_posts_at_request",
        "requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request",
        "requester_number_of_subreddits_at_request",
        "requester_subreddits_at_request",
        "requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_request",
        "requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request",
        "unix_timestamp_of_request",
        "unix_timestamp_of_request_utc",
    ]
    if "requester_received_pizza" in valid_cols and is_train:
        valid_cols.append("requester_received_pizza")

    # Clean up columns
    df = df[[c for c in df.columns if c in valid_cols]]
    return df

            )
        )
        .values.tolist()
    )

    test_text_vec = tfidf.transform(test_texts)
    test_X_vec = np.hstack([test_text_vec.todense(), test_nums.values])

    # Predict Test
    test_pred = model.predict_proba(test_X_vec)[:, 1]

    os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
